name: Vintage
description: Vintage is a constructed format with the largest legal card pool in Magic, allowing nearly all printed cards but enforcing a restricted list (some cards limited to a single copy per deck) and a small banned list. Because of the allowance of the most powerful cards, Vintage games often involve fast, high-power plays and deep strategy regarding resource management and restriction choices. Tournaments typically follow a strict policy for ante/restricted card handling and judge oversight.
rules_summary: 60-card minimum main deck; 15-card sideboard allowed; most cards legal but some are restricted (limit 1) and a few are banned; adhere to Vintage restricted list and tournament rules.
main_rules: Restricted list: certain cards are limited to one copy per deck (the Vintage restricted list).
Card legality: nearly all printed cards are legal unless explicitly banned or restricted.
Banned list: very small; restricted list is the primary balancing mechanism.
Tournament play: strict judge enforcement due to complexity and power level.
allowed_sets: All printed Magic sets except those explicitly excluded
